title: Checkout errors after payment deployment
text: After a payment service deployment, checkout requests returned HTTP 500 errors. A configuration change pointed the payment client to an unavailable endpoint. Rolling back the deployment restored checkout. Verify the payment endpoint configuration before redeploying.

title: Checkout latency from database connection exhaustion
text: Checkout requests became slow and timed out during a traffic spike. Database connection pool saturation caused requests to wait. Increasing the pool limit and reducing long-running queries restored service.

title: Delayed order confirmation emails
text: Order confirmation emails were delayed after the notification queue accumulated messages. A worker configuration error reduced processing capacity. Restoring the worker count cleared the backlog.

title: Payment failures caused by expired certificate
text: Payment requests failed because a client certificate expired. The payment gateway rejected TLS connections. Rotating the certificate restored payment processing and a certificate expiry alert was added.
